slug: 2025-12-01 Biometric Digital-ID in Africa - Ten Country Case Studies

facts.fact: The IDS Senegal country report states that the National Civil Registration Agency (ANEC) was established in May 2023 with the mission to digitalise, centralise and interconnect 689 civil registration centres through the centralised RNEC register, under the Ministry of Territorial Collectivities, which oversees national civil registration policy.

The report states that the EU is funding the creation of the national biometric civil registry (RNEC) through a partnership of ANEC, the French company CIVIPOL and the Belgian agency Enabel, under an EU Emergency Trust Fund for Africa programme costing EUR 28 million; no date is given for the statement, so the document's publication date is used.

The report states that Senegal's programme to computerise and digitalise civil registration has had 'substantial public funding' in addition to the creation of ANEC, giving no amount and no budget line; no date is given, so the document's publication date is used.

The report, citing ANEC 2025, states that the civil status management application Nekkal 'is being deployed' in 400 civil status centres, against the 689 civil registration centres it gives as ANEC's remit; it does not say how many of the 400 register events in it.
